Privacy Policy

We collect your precise location from GPS while the app is open to show nearby gyms. We also use analytics tools to understand how you use the app.

  • We share your device identifiers and advertising ID with advertising partners for personalized ads.
  • We do not collect your contacts or address book information.
  • We do not sell your data, but we collect crash reports and diagnostics to improve stability.
  • You can contact us at privacy@example.com for any questions about this policy.

We never record audio or access your microphone.
